definitions.explanation: A register kept at a Buddhist temple or by a family, recording the names, death dates, and posthumous Buddhist names of deceased family members.

definitions.gloss: thing of the past; forgotten record
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, something that has been relegated to the past and is no longer relevant.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{過去帳|かこちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I checked the death register at the temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命日|めいにち}→命日：17539_meinichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{過去帳|かこちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: I opened the family memorial record to find out the anniversary of my ancestor's death.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{過去帳|かこちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}されている→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: This death register preserves records of the clan dating back to the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{過去帳|かこちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: That company can be written off as a thing of the past.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{過去帳|かこちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}った→載る：27882_noru⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: The once-popular singer has now become a completely forgotten figure.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{過去帳|かこちょう}{入|い}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: That technology has been consigned to history along with the passage of time.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧ (past, the dead) and ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (notebook, register). Originally a Buddhist term for the register of the dead kept at temples, recording {戒名|かいみょう} (posthumous Buddhist names), dates of death, and secular names.

These records are important historical documents for tracing family lineage and are consulted during Buddhist memorial services (⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧). In its figurative sense, {過去帳|かこちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}る means to become obsolete or forgotten.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過去帳|かこちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check the death register
- {過去帳|かこちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記|しる}す→記す：14238_shirusu⟧: to record in the death register
- {過去帳|かこちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}る: to become a thing of the past
- {過去帳|かこちょう}{入|い}り: being relegated to the past

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{位牌|いはい}→位牌：07132_ihai⟧: memorial tablet — a physical tablet placed on the Buddhist altar for the deceased
- {家系図|かけいず}: family tree — a chart showing family lineage, not specifically for the deceased
- {戒名|かいみょう}: posthumous Buddhist name — the name given to the deceased, recorded in the {過去帳|かこちょう}
